name: 2.9-3.2GHz High-Power Unidirectional Amplifier for Advanced Drone & FPV Systems

Custom power and frequency configurations are available to meet specific operational requirements. ACASOM 2.9-3.2GHz Unidirectional Amplifier for Drone FPV & UAV Platforms Features: Transmit Channel (TX) Only – No RX: Optimized for boosting critical downlink signals such as HD FPV video feeds. Frequency: 2.9-3.2GHz. RF Output Power: 40/43 dBm (10W/20W) – Dramatically extends video and control range. Custom Solutions: ACASOM supports custom power and frequency configurations to fit your specific drone or FPV system needs!
